description: This file defines API routes for exporting pain management data as FHIR resources, including endpoints for exporting a FHIR bundle of all pain events for a user and exporting individual pain events as FHIR Observations. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and custom FHIR mapping functions.

classes.name: FHIRExport
classes.description: Model representing a FHIR export record, including the pain event ID, resource type, and FHIR data.

methods.name: export_fhir_bundle( current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve and compile all pain events of the current user into a FHIR Bundle.

methods.name: export_pain_event( pain_event_id: int, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to export a specific pain event as a FHIR Observation resource and save the export record.

ctags.name: export_fhir_bundle
ctags.signature: ( current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: export_pain_event
ctags.signature: ( pain_event_id: int, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
